title: Shining Staver-of-Skulls
summary: A +1 light hammer with Radiant melee damage and an always-on light aura.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d4 + 1 Bludgeoning plus Strength and 1d4 Radiant on melee hits. Simple, light, thrown, dippable. The Radiant bonus does not apply when thrown.
fields.Light: 25 ft radius while equipped. Cannot be toggled off.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. Deal weapon damage on hit. Constitution save vs higher of spell save DC or weapon-action DC +2 avoids Dazed for 2 turns. Dazed removes Dexterity AC bonus and reactions and gives disadvantage on Wisdom saves. Help ends it.
fields.Acquisition: Buy or loot from Corsair Greymon. The dialogue shove permanently loses his loot, while an in-combat drowning can leave his body on the Decrepit Village beach.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
